question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The professor’s lecture was filled with __profound__ insights on the subject matter.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Deep**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Profound **means having deep insight or understanding; showing intellectual depth or seriousness. (अगाध)

 
 
• **Example**: *Her speech contained profound wisdom that resonated with the audience.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Deep** means extending far down or inwards from the surface; having great depth. (गहरा)
 
 
• **Example**:* The ocean is incredibly deep, with depths that remain unexplored by humans.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Accidental **means happening by chance or without intention; unplanned or unintentional. (आकस्मिक)
 
• **Shallow **means lacking depth; not deep or profound in thought, understanding, or feeling. (उथला)
 
• **Superficial **means existing or occurring at or on the surface; shallow or not thorough. (सतही)
